basic_info.description: Charming Golden Gate Heights fully detached home with gorgeous views of the Bay, Angel Island, Marin and SF.  Timeless craftsman architecture and sophisticated interior design touches in a verdant peaceful retreat. Top level: gracious entry foyer; Living Room with wood burning fireplace and abundant natural light; Formal Dining Room; remodeled Kitchen with eat-in dining banquette and walk out deck with views; two full Bedrooms; remodeled Bathroom with two sinks, marble, deep soaking tub. Lower level:  Family Room that opens out to a verdant backyard with mature trees and landscaping, as well as a seating/ fire pit area; a full Bedroom; generous Laundry Room with Washer/Dryer; and interior access to garage. Plus - behind a mirrored door, a 'hidden' Bonus Room with day bed and full bathroom that features a sauna and shower!  Additional features include an attic, large storage spaces, and solar panels. Recently painted interior and exterior.  Close to Muni transportation for an easy commute to downtown, and a short distance from the shops and cafes of Inner Sunset and West Portal.
